## Spirit Airlines (SAVE / SAVEQ) — FY 2024 Operating KPIs

Source: FY2024 Form 10-K (filed March 3, 2025), MD&A — "Comparative Operating Statistics" table for the twelve months ended December 31, 2024 (unaudited). This is the complete set of operating KPIs the company reports as its operating statistics:

| # | Operating KPI | FY 2024 | FY 2023 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Average aircraft | 209.9 | 199.5 | +5.2% |
| 2 | Aircraft at end of period | 213 | 205 | +3.9% |
| 3 | Average daily aircraft utilization (hours) | 9.9 | 11.1 | (10.8)% |
| 4 | Departures | 288,180 | 297,900 | (3.3)% |
| 5 | Passenger flight segments (PFSs) (thousands) | 44,180 | 44,105 | +0.2% |
| 6 | Revenue passenger miles (RPMs) (thousands) | 43,671,009 | 45,243,787 | (3.5)% |
| 7 | Available seat miles (ASMs) (thousands) | 53,017,948 | 55,665,561 | (4.8)% |
| 8 | Load factor (%) | 82.4% | 81.3% | +1.1 pts |
| 9 | Total revenue per passenger flight segment ($) | $111.21 | $121.58 | (8.5)% |
| 10 | Average yield (cents) | 11.25¢ | 11.85¢ | (5.1)% |
| 11 | TRASM — total revenue per ASM (cents) | 9.27¢ | 9.63¢ | (3.7)% |
| 12 | CASM — operating cost per ASM (cents) | 11.35¢ | 10.52¢ | +7.9% |
| 13 | Adjusted CASM (cents) | 10.76¢ | 10.33¢ | +4.2% |
| 14 | Adjusted CASM ex-fuel (cents) | 7.97¢ | 7.06¢ | +12.9% |
| 15 | Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) | 551,819 | 591,796 | (6.8)% |
| 16 | Average fuel cost per gallon ($) | $2.68 | $3.08 | (13.0)% |

Notes:
- Aircraft at end of period (213) **includes 21 aircraft recorded as assets held for sale** on the December 31, 2024 balance sheet (23 A320ceo/A321ceo aircraft under a sale agreement with GA Telesis; 2 sold in December 2024).
- Adjusted CASM excludes loss (gain) on disposal of assets, special charges, furlough-related expenses and litigation loss contingency adjustments; Adjusted CASM ex-fuel further excludes aircraft fuel and related taxes.
- In the quarterly earnings releases (which present a slightly longer "Selected Operating Statistics" table), Spirit additionally tracks **fare revenue per passenger flight segment ($)**, **non-ticket revenue per passenger flight segment ($)** and **average stage length (miles)**; those three are not carried into the 10-K's annual table.
- Context: FY2024 operating revenue was $4,913.4M (−8.4%), operating loss $1,105.4M (operating margin −22.5%), net loss $1,229.5M.
judge_reason: All 16 FY2024 operating KPI totals are stated with matching values, with unit conversions equivalent to the official answer.
